q: Page size 4 KB (4096 bytes) hai. Logical address 13000, aur page 3 frame 5 mein hai. Physical address kya hoga?
Paging ke baare mein kaunsa sahi hai?
options: Internal fragmentation last page mein ho sakti hai
Dono external aur internal zyada hoti hain
explain: Saare frames same size ke hone se external fragmentation nahi hoti; sirf last page mein thodi internal waste ho sakti hai.

q: Free holes 100, 500, 200, 300, 600 KB hain. First fit se 417 KB process kis hole mein jaayega (212 KB pehle hi 500 ko 288 bana chuka hai)?
explain: First fit upar se pehla fit hole leta hai; 288/200/300 chhote hain, isliye 417 KB 600 KB hole mein jaata hai.

q: 32-bit logical address aur 4 KB page size par ek single-level page table mein kitni entries hongi?
explain: Offset 12 bits, page number 20 bits -> 2^20 = 1,048,576 entries. 4-byte entry par table 4 MB ki banti hai.
